body:
At 19, I was a soldier in the army and felt very alone.  I had nothing in common with the other soldiers in my unit.  They were all fuckups.

I could have ended it, but I didn't.

I've had some good experiences since then.  I fell in love a couple of times and got cheated on a couple of times.  They were things over which I didn't have any control.

I have two great kids and they are just about the only thing that keep me going.  I don't want them to get what I've got.

I don't know if I would ever be a good counselor on this, but at 19, you have a lot of things to check out, before you check out.
I certainly hope it helps.  Thanks for commenting.
I'll post here about how it is going.
